text: {"lessons":["I tend to sell positions once they show a gain, especially a large one; a gain feels satisfying, but that alone doesn’t tell me whether selling is wise.","Each stock can feel like its own account, yet my decisions should consider the whole portfolio and my cash, not just whether one position is above its average cost.","Prices move randomly, so recent gains or losses are not reliable forecasts; I should avoid overtrading and make decisions based on my overall plan."]}
